title: Can You Survive the F/A-18 Hornet Challenge using an Xbox controller? | MSFS World Update 21
description:
They say you shouldn't bring a gamepad to a dogfight—but what about a landing challenge? With the release of MSFS World Update 21: Australia, I decided to take the Boeing F/A-18 Super Hornet for a spin at the newly handcrafted RAAF Base Tindal (YPTN).

The catch? I’m doing it all on an Xbox controller.

Between trying to figure out the gear toggle and managing the insane approach speed of the Hornet compared to GA planes, things nearly went horribly wrong. We ignored the PAPI lights, came in high, and fought the thumbsticks the whole way down. But somehow, we didn't just survive - we actually cracked the Top 10 on the leaderboard.

In this video:

- Location: RAAF Base Tindal / Katherine Tindal Airport (YPTN)
- Update: World Update 21 Australia (New Handcrafted Airport)
- Aircraft: Boeing F/A-18E/F Super Hornet
- Challenge: Precision Landing Challenge

If you're exploring the new Australia update or wondering if MSFS is playable on a controller, this one is for you. Like and subscribe for more MSFS challenges and aviation chaos!
